about: Built by tools/ui_data.mjs from sections/*/places.json; do not edit. u, v: the landmark on the scan (scroll HUD marks).

inner_city.name: 十字街
inner_city.sub_en: The Busy Market Inside the City

landmarks.name: 沿河雅座
landmarks.line: 臨河的飯館，開窗看汴水。
landmarks.line_en: A restaurant on the bank, windows open to the Bian waters.

landmarks.name: 王家紙馬
landmarks.line: 清明上墳的紙馬，都在這裏買。
landmarks.line_en: Paper horses for Qingming graves are all bought here.

landmarks.name: 望火樓
landmarks.line: 樓上本該有人瞭望，如今空著。
landmarks.line_en: Someone should be up there keeping watch. No one is.

landmarks.name: 望樓飯鋪
landmarks.line: 望火樓下的飯鋪。
landmarks.name_en: The Eating Shops by the Tower
landmarks.line_en: The eating shops beneath the fire tower.

landmarks.name: 趙太丞家
landmarks.line: 門前招牌：治酒所傷真方集香丸。
landmarks.line_en: The sign: a true remedy, Incense Pills, for wine-sickness.

landmarks.name: 官宦人家
landmarks.line: 門房前，有人問路。
landmarks.line_en: At the gatehouse, someone asks the way.

landmarks.name: 草橋
landmarks.line: 馱炭的驢隊，正要過橋進城。
landmarks.line_en: Charcoal donkeys about to cross the bridge into town.

landmarks.name: 穀場
landmarks.line: 農家的穀場，此時正靜。
landmarks.line_en: The farmyard threshing floor, quiet for now.

landmarks.name: 隋堤煙柳
landmarks.line: 堤上老柳，人稱隋堤。
landmarks.line_en: The old willows on the bank are called the Sui Embankment.

landmarks.name: 踏青歸來
landmarks.line: 轎頂插著楊柳雜花，掃墓回城。
landmarks.line_en: Willow and flowers on the sedan's roof: back from sweeping graves.

landmarks.name: 稅務
landmarks.line: 貨到稅訖，車夫在此納稅。
landmarks.line_en: Goods arrive, tax is paid; the carters settle up here.

landmarks.name: 軍巡鋪屋
landmarks.line: 本是防火的鋪屋，如今堆滿酒桶。
landmarks.line_en: Once a fire-watch post, now stacked with wine casks.

landmarks.name: 城樓
landmarks.line: 樓內架著一面大鼓，暮時擊鼓。
landmarks.line_en: A great drum hangs inside, beaten at dusk.

landmarks.name: 平橋
landmarks.line: 橋欄邊，人看春水游魚。
landmarks.line_en: At the railings, people watch spring water and fish.

landmarks.name: 孫羊正店
landmarks.line: 京師正店之一，門首縛綵樓歡門。
landmarks.line_en: One of the capital's main taverns, with a festive gate tower.

landmarks.name: 孫羊店
landmarks.line: 肉案上掛著羊肺羊肚。
landmarks.line_en: Lamb lungs and tripe hang on the counter.

landmarks.name: 街頭說書
landmarks.line: 說話人說三分，聽客圍了一圈。
landmarks.line_en: The storyteller tells a tale; the listeners ring round him.

landmarks.name: 久住王員外家
landmarks.line: 客店，樓上有士子讀書。
landmarks.line_en: An inn; upstairs a scholar studies.

landmarks.name: 劉家香藥鋪
landmarks.line: 招牌寫著：劉家上色沉檀揀香。
landmarks.line_en: The sign reads: Liu Family, Finest Selected Aloeswood and Sandalwood.

landmarks.name: 「解」字招牌
landmarks.line: 士子圍著老者，打聽科場消息。
landmarks.line_en: Scholars gather round an old man, asking about the exams.

landmarks.name: 方井
landmarks.line: 井口架成田字，四人可同時汲水。
landmarks.line_en: The well-mouth is framed like the character “field,” so four can draw at once.

landmarks.name: 寺院
landmarks.line: 山門緊閉，僧人從側門進去。
landmarks.line_en: The gate is shut; a monk slips in by the side door.

landmarks.name: 遞鋪
landmarks.line: 兵卒等著差官，等得乏了。
landmarks.line_en: Soldiers wait for an official, worn out with waiting.

landmarks.name: 臨街神算
landmarks.line: 招牌寫著：神課、看命。
landmarks.line_en: The signs read: Divination, Reading Fates.

landmarks.name: 大棕蓋車
landmarks.line: 富戶人家的車，棕葉蓋頂。
landmarks.line_en: A rich family's cart, roofed with palm fibre.

landmarks.name: 車鋪
landmarks.line: 匠人在修大車的輪子。
landmarks.line_en: A craftsman mends a big cart's wheel.

landmarks.name: 小鋪閒坐
landmarks.line: 路邊小鋪，有人閒坐吃茶。
landmarks.name_en: The Little Shop Where People Sit
landmarks.line_en: A roadside shop; someone sits over tea.

landmarks.name: 虹橋
landmarks.line: 其橋無柱，宛如飛虹。
landmarks.line_en: The bridge has no piers, like a flying rainbow.

landmarks.name: 十千腳店
landmarks.line: 腳店門首，也縛著綵樓歡門。
landmarks.line_en: This small tavern also has a festive welcome gate.

landmarks.name: 新酒
landmarks.line: 酒旗上寫著「新酒」。
landmarks.line_en: The wine flag reads “New Wine.”
